نستعذي (form X)
# نَسْتَعْذِي (nastaʕḏī) /nas.taʕ.ðiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْذَى (istaʕḏā)
# نَسْتَعْذِيَ (nastaʕḏiya) /nas.taʕ.ði.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَعْذَى (istaʕḏā)
